metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Middle Back Pain in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to help relieve middle back pain in as little as 30 seconds.

A major cause of middle back pain is a buildup of tightness and weakness in the main muscles that support this area. These muscles include the rhomboids, trapezius, and latissimus dorsi.

To address this, we’ll go over exercises that stretch and strengthen these key muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently and targets different muscles. For the best results, go through them all and use the exercises that provide the most relief.

Watch now and quickly relieve middle back pain!
